etc/systemd/system/hexagonrpcd-adsp-root:
[Unit]
ConditionPathExists=/run/gts9-ssc-test/ready
StartLimitIntervalSec=infinity
StartLimitBurst=1

[Service]
Restart=no
TimeoutStopSec=10s
ExecStart=
ExecStart=/usr/bin/hexagonrpcd -f /dev/fastrpc-adsp -d adsp -R /usr/share/qcom/sm8550/Samsung/gts9wifi
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ReadWritePaths=/usr/share/qcom/sm8550/Samsung/gts9wifi/sensors
etc/systemd/system/hexagonrpcd-adsp-sens:
[Unit]
ConditionPathExists=/run/gts9-ssc-test/ready
StartLimitIntervalSec=infinity
StartLimitBurst=1

[Service]
Restart=no
TimeoutStopSec=10s
ExecStart=
ExecStart=/usr/bin/hexagonrpcd -f /dev/fastrpc-adsp -d adsp -s -R /usr/share/qcom/sm8550/Samsung/gts9wifi
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ReadWritePaths=/usr/share/qcom/sm8550/Samsung/gts9wifi/sensors
